title: 2022 NHSN HAI Rebaseline Progress Tracker | NHSN |CDC
content: 2022 NHSN HAI Rebaseline Progress Tracker Print Minus Related Pages Return to 2022 NHSN HAI Rebaseline Home Page Important Message: SIR and SUR reports using 2022 Rebaseline models are being added to the application in a phased approach. New educational materials are being posted to this webpage on a rolling basis as they become available. Some resources may be relevant for SIR models that are not yet available in NHSN reports. Please check back regularly for ongoing updates. New NHSN risk adjustment models based on the 2022 Rebaseline are being created in a phased approach. The 2022 NHSN HAI Rebaseline Progress Tracker provides the most up-to-date information regarding the status of the 2022 Rebaseline as the NHSN team moves through the various stages of the project. Please re-visit this page for regular updates on NHSN’s Rebaseline progress. View archived Rebaseline announcements Stages of the 2022 HAI Rebaseline Last updated 4/ 9 /2026 Progress Stage Progress Stage Progress Stage Description Description Description Status Status Status Planning Progress Stage Planning Establishing the timeline, scope, roles, and plan for the 2022 HAI Rebaseline project. Developing an initial communications and partner outreach strategy, including sharing preliminary plans with external partners such as the Centers for Medicare and Medicaid Services (CMS). Freezing NHSN HAI data from 2022; preparing analytic datasets that will be used for subsequent modeling work. Description Establishing the timeline, scope, roles, and plan for the 2022 HAI Rebaseline project. Developing an initial communications and partner outreach strategy, including sharing preliminary plans with external partners such as the Centers for Medicare and Medicaid Services (CMS). Freezing NHSN HAI data from 2022; preparing analytic datasets that will be used for subsequent modeling work. Stage Complete Status Stage Complete Research Progress Stage Research Conducting a literature review of recent studies that identified factors that are potentially associated, or not associated, with the incidence of HAIs. Evaluating clinical significance of potential risk factors to inform risk adjustment decisions. Evaluating clinical significance of potential risk factors to inform risk adjustment decisions. Stage Complete Status Stage Complete Analysis and Model Development Progress Stage Analysis and Model Development Creating and validating new risk adjustment models. Creating methodological standards to be applied across the development and validation of these statistical models. Engaging with subject matter experts in review of model results. Stage Complete Status Stage Complete Model Implementation Progress Stage Model Implementation Developing standards and requirements for incorporating 2022 risk adjustment models into the NHSN application and datasets. Testing and deploying analysis reports for new SIR and SUR models within the NHSN application. Testing and deploying analysis reports for new SIR and SUR models within the NHSN application. In Progress Status In Progress Education & Communication Progress Stage Education & Communication Updating NHSN users and other stakeholders about the 2022 HAI Rebaseline project via blast email, the NHSN Newsletter, and/or other communication channels. Developing content including Quick Reference Guides, webinars, websites, and Quick Learns to educate NHSN users and stakeholders about using and interpreting SIRs and SURs calculated under the new baseline. Developing content including Quick Reference Guides, webinars, websites, and Quick Learns to educate NHSN users and stakeholders about using and interpreting SIRs and SURs calculated under the new baseline. In Progress Status In Progress Adoption, Integration, & Collaboration Progress Stage Adoption, Integration, & Collaboration Ensuring that Federal, State, and other partners are informed and supported during the implementation of the new risk adjustment models. Collaborating with Centers for Medicare and Medicaid Services (CMS) to work towards future adoption of the 2022 baseline SIRs into CMS programs. Integrating new risk adjustment models into various CDC downstream products and publications, such as the National & State HAI Progress Report. In Progress Status In Progress Model Implementation: Availability of SIR and SUR Reports in NHSN Last updated 4/ 9 /2026 New SIR and SUR reports are being built in the NHSN application as part of the 2022 HAI Rebaseline. These reports provide NHSN users with SIR and SUR values calculated using new risk adjustment models.
